what: Prosperity Bancshares is a Texas bank, lending to businesses and households across Texas and Oklahoma from about 280 branches, with an unusually conservative lending record.
customers: Small and mid-sized businesses and households in Houston, Dallas and across Texas.
money: commercial and consumer lending funded by deposits
moat: A deposit base built across Texas over decades of acquisitions, and a lending culture conservative enough that it came through every recent downturn with minimal losses.
risks: Loan growth has been slow because the bank declines business it considers mispriced
Revenue has been flat around $1.2B for several years
Texas commercial real estate is a meaningful exposure
opportunities: 12.8 times earnings with a 43.4% net margin, among the highest of any American bank
Analysts see about 15% upside, with 15 covering the stock
Texas keeps gaining people and businesses, and the bank is positioned to buy smaller Texas banks
watch: Loan growth and the efficiency ratio, which is among the best in American banking.
